* Broadcom to deploy racks of AI accelerator and network systems targeted to start in the second half of 2026, to complete by end of 2029

SAN FRANCISCO and PALO ALTO, Calif., Oct. 13, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- OpenAI and Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ: AVGO) today announced a collaboration for 10 gigawatts of custom AI accelerators. OpenAI will design the accelerators and systems, which will be developed and deployed in partnership with Broadcom. By designing its own chips and systems, OpenAI can embed what it’s learned from developing frontier models and products directly into the hardware, unlocking new levels of capability and intelligence. The racks, scaled entirely with Ethernet and other connectivity solutions from Broadcom, will meet surging global demand for AI, with deployments across OpenAI’s facilities and partner data centers.

OpenAI and Broadcom have long-standing agreements on the co-development and supply of the AI accelerators. The two companies have signed a term sheet to deploy racks incorporating the AI accelerators and Broadcom networking solutions.

“Partnering with Broadcom is a critical step in building the infrastructure needed to unlock AI’s potential and deliver real benefits for people and businesses,” said Sam Altman, co-founder and CEO of OpenAI. “Developing our own accelerators adds to the broader ecosystem of partners all building the capacity required to push the frontier of AI to provide benefits to all humanity.”

“Broadcom’s collaboration with OpenAI signifies a pivotal moment in the pursuit of artificial general intelligence,” said Hock Tan, President and CEO of Broadcom Inc.

[Carrington Malin](https://substack.com/@middleeastainews)

**#UAE #GITEXGLOBAL2025 -** US semiconductor manufacturer [Intel Corporation](https://www.linkedin.com/company/intel-corporation/) has signed a strategic partnership memorandum of understanding with Abu Dhabi-based artificial intelligence company [AIREV](https://www.linkedin.com/company/airev-holding-limited/) to accelerate agentic AI adoption across the Middle East and globally. Via the collaboration, AIREV will optimise its [OnDemand](https://www.linkedin.com/company/on-demandio/) sovereign agentic operating system for Intel’s portfolio of Xeon processors and Gaudi AI accelerators. Intel and AIREV plan to deliver comprehensive AI solutions spanning latency-sensitive small-scale inference through to large-scale training of advanced language models, on the Intel platform. The two companies will also plan joint go-to-market activities to deliver scalable, secure and high-performance AI tailored to to enterprises and government entities.

**SO WHAT? -** Semiconductor manufacturers are increasingly looking for partnerships with AI platforms to optimise hardware and software integration for specific customer segments. The new partnership with AIREV illustrates how firms like Intel are now looking beyond device manufacturers and traditional hyperscaler ecosystems to the new generation of AI platforms. Joint go-to-market activities including co-selling, co-marketing, demonstrations and pilot deployments stand to benefit customers seeking platforms to support the development of agentic AI solutions.

Here are some key details about the Intel-AIREV announcement:

* Santa Clara-based semiconductor manufacturer [Intel Corporation](https://www.linkedin.com/company/intel-corporation/) has signed an MoU with Abu Dhabi-based artificial intelligence company [AIREV](https://www.linkedin.com/company/airev-holding-limited/) to optimisation of AIREV’s [OnDemand](https://www.linkedin.com/company/on-demandio/) platform on Intel Xeon processors and Gaudi AI accelerators, and accelerate agentic AI adoption.
* Intel and AIREV aim to deliver comprehensive AI solutions from latency-sensitive small-scale inference to large-scale training of advanced language models, enabling enterprises and government entities to access scalable, secure and high-performance AI solutions.
* The partnership will also leverage Intel’s partner ecosystem to co-develop innovative on-premises and cloud-based AI solutions for diverse enterprise needs.
* The Intel-AIREV agreement will include a comprehensive go-to-market strategy designed to accelerate enterprise AI innovation through co-selling, co-marketing, demonstrations, pilots and workshops.
* Intel and AIREV will jointly optimise and validate AIREV’s OnDemand solution on Intel Xeon and Gaudi platforms.
* Intel Gaudi 3 accelerators feature 128 gigabytes of high bandwidth memory and 3.7 terabytes per second bandwidth, optimised for large language models and computer vision workloads paired with fifth-generation Intel Xeon processors delivering up to 64 cores and PCIe Generation 5 slots.
* AIREV is a UAE-based AI company pioneering agentic systems through its flagship OnDemand platform, enabling organisations to unlock autonomous agents securely designed to operate across air-gapped, private or hybrid environments at scale and with trust.

Broadcom emphasizes performance, power efficiency, and low‑latency connectivity in its positioning for high‑growth markets.
